{{DISPLAYTITLE:Cyril (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:Cyril.PNG|thumb|right|The town of Cyril.]]
{{Quote|Busy town. The monster bank is on its outskirts.|Description}}
'''Cyril''' {{j|始まりの街シリル|Hajimari no machi Shiriru|Cyril, city of beginnings}} is the [[Human|hume]] [[town]] from ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It is here that [[Marche Radiuju]] begins his adventure in [[Ivalice (Tactics Advance)|Ivalice]] and also where his first engagement is held.

Later, [[Montblanc]] is introduced and Marche becomes a part of his clan.

==Locations==
[[File:Cyril.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Cyril, a pleasant but busy town.]]
===The Prancing Chocobo===
"The Prancing Chocobo" is the name of the pub in Cyril. It is a popular clan watering hole and where the recent pub rumors can be read and missions can be accepted or canceled. Its name is a reference to "The Prancing Pony" from ''The Lord of the Rings''.

===Ramsen Armory===
The "Ramsen Armory" is the name of the local shop in Cyril. Here, discounts are given on weaponry wielded by humes.

Discounts are given on:
*Swords ([[Soldier (Tactics Advance)|Soldier]])
*Blades ([[Fighter (Tactics Advance)|Fighter]])
*Sabers ([[Blue Mage (Tactics Advance)|Blue Mage]])
*Knightswords ([[Paladin (Tactics Advance)|Paladin]])
*Greatswords (Soldier)
*Knives ([[Thief (Tactics Advance)|Thief]])
*Katanas ([[Ninja (Tactics Advance)|Ninja]])
*Staves ([[White Mage (Tactics Advance)|White Mage]])
*Rods ([[Black Mage (Tactics Advance)|Black Mage]]/[[Illusionist (Tactics Advance)|Illusionist]])
*Bows ([[Archer (Tactics Advance)|Archer]])
*Greatbows ([[Hunter (Tactics Advance)|Hunter]])

===Monster Bank===
{{Quote|Welcome to the monster bank. Your monster awaits!|Monster Bank Morpher}}
[[File:CyrilMonsterBank.png|right|thumb|200px|The monster bank on Cyril's outskirts.]]
{{Main|Monster Bank}}
The "Monster Bank" is the holding place for all monsters captured by Hunters. It is similar to a zoo, as there are holding pens for all of the monsters. It is run by a [[Morpher]], who has a unique bond with the monsters. In order to develop a powerful Morpher, one will have to capture as many monsters as possible, and then raise them by feeding them.
{{clear}}

==Liberation of Cyril==
Early in the game, after completion of "#068 Fowl Thief!", "#194 Free Cyril" is unlocked. It is a simple three day dispatch assignment. Afterward, Cyril is liberated and never will come under attack.
